prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other driver's vehicle sideswiped our client's vehicle while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and has retained this firm to pursue all available claims.

Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of the insurer has previously spoken with our client, please note that our client has no obligation to provide further statements.

We request that you provide the policy limits for all applicable liability coverage held by your insured, along with the declarations page confirming those limits.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics footage, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any repair or total loss records. Please treat this letter as formal notice to preserve all such materials pending resolution of this claim.
